ad_preview.headline: Shop your favourites now

items.description: The Grain sneaker is a tactile, outdoor-inspired silhouette grounded in texture and function. Defined by an exaggerated T-toe, the upper combines nubuck, hairy suede and gingham lining, and is finished with fluffy laces for added depth. A Vibram Snowshoe outsole delivers grip and structure, while a cushioned EVA midsole and leather footbed ensure everyday comfort.
items.title: Grain Sneaker

items.description: The Clean 90 Cap-Toe Sneaker is a refined low-top, handmade in Portugal from smooth leather. A pair features flat laces and a cap-toe detail, while the lining combines leather and PU for comfort. Gold foil branding accents the side, and the elevated rubber sole is made with recycled content.
items.title: Clean 90 Cap-Toe Sneaker

items.description: The Dice Laceless is a minimal interpretation of an Axel Arigato icon. Featuring sleek, simplified uppers, this model is handcrafted from LWG-certified suede that’s backed with a comfortable leather, microfiber and recycled polyester lining. They’re set on branded soles that incorporate recycled rubber.
items.title: Dice Laceless Sneaker

items.description:
The Bubble Reverse T-Shirt is crafted from a lightweight blend of 85% organic cotton and 15% hemp, offering an oversized fit for a relaxed silhouette. This unique piece features a specialized spray technique that creates a faded color effect, making each shirt unique. An 'Axel Arigato' print adorns the back, adding something more refined.

The model is 188 cm / 6'2 ft and wears a size M.
items.title: Bubble Reverse T-Shirt

items.description:
The Verve Zip-Up Cardigan features a boiled 100% wool knit for texture and warmth. Cut in a regular fit, it’s detailed with a branded two-way zip and side pockets. Due to the boiled treatment of the garment, we recommend taking extra caution when washing.

The model is 180 cm / 5'11 ft and wears a size S.
items.title: Verve Zip-Up Cardigan

items.description: The Dice Lo B-Bird Sneaker draws from dual sources of inspiration, nodding to ’70s track and field runners as well as ’90s skate shoes. Handcrafted with contrasting panels of leather, suede, and recycled polyester, the design is finished with signature bee bird embroidery for a subtle branded touch.
items.title: Dice Lo Bee Bird Sneaker

items.description: The Slow Shearling Runner’s layered, low-profile silhouette takes on a new dimension with an all-over suede construction and real shearling lining — a first for the style. Inspired by the Marathon Runner, the upper is built from rich suede panels with knit-inspired details that nod to our ready-to-wear collections. Handmade in Portugal, it’s finished with debossed bubble branding, a 7mm rubber sole, and European sizing. The shearling-lined interior brings added warmth and comfort to the deconstructed design.
items.title: Slow Shearling Runner

items.description: The Area Lo sneaker pays homage to ‘90s basketball styles. Handcrafted from premium leather and recycled polyester, it has paneled uppers finished with perforations and heel spoilers.
items.title: Area Lo Fluffy Sneaker

items.description: The Dice T-Toe sneaker draws from dual sources of inspiration, nodding to ‘70s track and field runners, as well as ‘90s skate shoes. It has contrasting uppers that are handcrafted from leather, suede and recycled polyester.
items.title: Dice T-Toe Sneaker

items.description: The Clay sneaker is a modern take on classic court styles from the ‘80s. Its low-profile silhouette is handcrafted from panels of leather and textile, and set on soles that are discreetly embossed with tennis net graphics.
items.title: Clay Sneaker

items.description: For the days when polish is non-negotiable.The Mercer is a structured everyday tote designed with clean lines and a timeless silhouette. Compact yet functional, it carries your essentials without feeling oversized — perfect for coffee runs, office hours, and nights out that come after. Crafted from smooth vegan leather, it’s soft to the touch but strong enough to keep its shape. Dual top handles make it easy to carry by hand or on the shoulder, while the minimal interior keeps things simple and light. Designed with AYVA’s signature balance of style and function, it’s the bag you’ll reach for every day. Details: Smooth vegan leather with structured shape Dual top handles for versatile carry Spacious interior for daily essentials Lightweight and durable Designed in Stockholm Size: 31 cm (W), 16 cm (H), 12 cm (D) Minimal, sleek, and made to last.That’s The Mercer.
items.title: The Mercer

items.description: For when less really is more.Maya is a compact shoulder bag designed to carry just what you need — and do it in style. With its softly structured silhouette and minimalist hardware, it’s the kind of bag that feels effortless whether you’re dressed up or keeping it casual. Lightweight and easy to wear, it slips comfortably under your arm and adds just the right amount of polish to any outfit. Inside, you’ll find enough space for your everyday essentials without the bulk, making it your go-to for coffee runs, date nights, and everything in between. Details: Smooth vegan leather with soft structure Adjustable shoulder strap for a perfect fit Zipper closure for security Spacious interior with simple organization Designed in Stockholm Size: 29 cm (W), 15 cm (H), 10 cm (D) Minimal, sleek, and made for every moment.That’s The Maya.
items.title: Maya Bag

items.description: For the days that don’t slow down.The Brooklyn is made to move, through city streets, train stations, meetings that run over, and plans that run late. With its sculpted silhouette and smooth vegan leather, it balances function with quiet confidence. Spacious, structured, and surprisingly lightweight, it fits everything you need without ever feeling bulky. Carry it by the soft shoulder straps or clip on the adjustable crossbody when you're on the go. From Monday commutes to weekend escapes, The Brooklyn doesn’t just keep up, it keeps you ahead. Crafted with the same materials and attention to detail as big-brand bags, but without the inflated markups. No logos, no shortcuts, no hype, just premium quality at an honest price. Details: Smooth-grain vegan leather with structured shape Top zipper closure and outer zip pockets Adjustable, removable crossbody strap Soft inner lining with compartments for easy organization Designed in Stockholm Size: 40 cm (L), 25 cm (H), 15 cm (W) Smart, polished, and built to last.That’s The Brooklyn.
items.title: The Brooklyn Bag
